result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the bottom navigation bar is visibly broken: the 'Orders' tab is missing its icon while all other tabs have one. There is also a small inconsistency in the favorite (heart) button styling between restaurant cards. Horizontal clipping of carousel items and the bottom-cut card were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: In the bottom tab bar, the 'Orders' tab shows only a text label with no icon above it, while Home, Search and Profile all display an icon plus label. This leaves an empty gap and makes the tab look broken/unrendered.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon (e.g., a receipt/bag outline) above the label so all four tabs share the same icon+label structure and vertical alignment.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button is styled inconsistently between cards: on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card the heart sits directly on the image with no backing shape, while on the pizza card below it has a dark circular background. This reduces legibility on lighter images and looks unpolished.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent circular scrim behind the heart icon on every restaurant card for consistent appearance and reliable contrast.
